reason: I'm not paying a subscription to invest. My broker already auto-buys the same index funds every month for free, so a monthly fee just eats into my returns on a pretty small balance.
objection: On under $20k, even $10 a month is a real chunk of what I'd make in a year. And I don't need an AI pet rebalancing a couple of index funds for me.
would_change_my_mind: If it were free or a flat fee that's tiny next to my balance, and it clearly beat what my broker's free recurring buys already do.
